candidates.change_summary: Return false instead of true at the end of the function.
Change the call selector from transferFrom to transfer so the behavior is an ERC-20 transfer instead of transferFrom.
Delete the require that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing calls with an empty array to return true without any external calls.
Replace `require(_s)` with `require(!_s)` so the transaction reverts on a successful external call instead of on failure.
Replace `return true` with `return false` so the function returns false on success.
Insert `require(false)` as the first statement so the function always reverts.
Delete the entire loop body so no external call is made, changing the return value’s semantic meaning (no transfers attempted).
